meta.overview:
- 主题：四篇文章依次讨论报纸艺术评论的衰落、商业方法专利面临的司法收紧、社会流行现象中“意见领袖”的真实作用，以及银行游说对会计准则制定独立性的侵蚀。
- 行文逻辑：各篇均从一种既有现象或流行认识出发，再借历史变迁、法院动向、传播研究或金融危机中的制度博弈揭示其局限，最终落到艺术评论传统难以复兴、商业方法专利前景受威胁、群体易感性比少数名人更关键，以及市场必须依靠独立准则制定者等结论上。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.en_title: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspaper…
reading.intro: 本篇主题：报纸艺术评论的衰落。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去四分之一个世纪里，英语报纸经历了种种变化，其中影响最为深远的，或许就是艺术报道在覆盖范围和严肃程度上不可阻挡的衰退。

paragraphs.en: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers. Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews. To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
paragraphs.zh: 对普通的 40 岁以下读者来说，要想象多数大城市报纸都能读到高质量艺术评论的年代，几乎是不可能的。 然而，20 世纪出版的许多最重要的评论文集，在很大程度上都是由报纸评论汇编而成的。 今天读到这样的书，人们不免惊叹：其中那些学术性很强的内容，竟曾被认为适合刊登在面向大众发行的日报上。

paragraphs.en: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared. In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered. Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about. These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press. "So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are.'"
paragraphs.zh: 而我们与另一种传统的距离甚至更远：从 20 世纪之交到第二次世界大战前夕，英国报纸曾刊登主题不受拘束的评论；当时新闻纸便宜得很，文笔优雅的艺术评论被视为给刊物增光添彩的点缀。 在那个久远的年代，人们理所当然地认为，大报评论家会对自己报道的事件作细致而充分的论述。 评论对他们而言是一项严肃的事业；即便像萧伯纳和欧内斯特·纽曼那样不刻意炫耀学问的评论家，也完全可以让人相信他们深知自己在谈什么。 这些人把新闻工作视为一种使命，并以自己的文章能刊登在日报上为荣。 纽曼写道：“有足够才智或文学天赋、能够在新闻写作中站稳脚跟的作家少之又少，以至于我忍不住想把‘新闻业’定义为：那些无人问津的作家用来贬低那些拥有读者的作家的一个词。”

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten. Neville Cardus, who wrote for the *Manchester Guardian* from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket. During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his *Autobiography* (1947) became a best-seller. He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored. Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，这些评论家如今几乎已被遗忘。 内维尔·卡杜斯从 1917 年起一直为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿，直到 1975 年去世前不久；如今人们只知道他是一位板球随笔作家。 然而在世时，他还是英国最杰出的古典音乐评论家之一，也是一位广受推崇的文体家，就连他 1947 年出版的《自传》都成了畅销书。 1967 年，他被授予爵士称号，成为第一位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。 然而如今他的著作只有一本仍在印行，他浩繁的音乐评论也只有专业人士知晓。

paragraphs.en: Is there any chance that Cardus's criticism will enjoy a revival? The prospect seems remote. Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized. Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
paragraphs.zh: 卡杜斯的评论还有可能重新受到重视吗？ 这种可能性似乎十分渺茫。 早在他去世之前，新闻写作的审美趣味就已经改变；后现代读者也不欣赏他所擅长的那种辞藻华美、兼具维多利亚与爱德华时代风格的散文。 此外，音乐评论领域的业余评论传统也一直在急剧衰退。

questions.stem: It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that
options: arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers.
English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews.
high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers.
young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies.
questions.explain:
正确项：English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews. 首段说艺术报道的覆盖范围和严肃性如今不断下降，第二段又指出 20 世纪许多重要评论文集主要来自报纸评论。今昔对比表明，英语报纸过去刊载的艺术评论更多、更有分量。
其他选项：A. arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers.：绝对化。原文说的是衰退，并未说艺术评论已经完全消失。；C. high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers.：无中生有。原文讨论的是高质量艺术评论及其载体，不是高质量报纸的读者规模。；D. young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies.：偷换含义。年轻读者是难以想象过去的繁荣景象，并非怀疑评论是否适合刊登在日报上。
questions.evidence:
Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.

questions.stem: Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by
options: free themes.
casual style.
elaborate layout.
radical viewpoints.
questions.explain:
正确项：free themes. 定位句用 unfocused 描述当时的报纸评论，表示评论不受狭窄主题约束、选题自由；free themes 是对此的同义概括。
其他选项：B. casual style.：张冠李戴。原文后文的 wore their learning lightly 说的是少数评论家不炫耀学识，不等于评论整体采用随意文风。；C. elaborate layout.：无中生有。原文谈评论内容与写法，没有谈版面设计。；D. radical viewpoints.：无中生有。unfocused 指题材不受限制，不代表观点激进。
questions.evidence: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.

questions.stem: Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on?
options: It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals.
It is contemptible for writers to be journalists.
Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism.
Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing.
questions.explain:
正确项：Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing. 纽曼指出，具备足够才智或文学天赋、能够胜任新闻写作的作者很少，明确说明并非所有作家都具备新闻写作能力。萧伯纳与纽曼都属于作者称许的专业评论家，二人会认同这一专业门槛。
其他选项：A. It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals.：无中生有。把新闻工作视为使命不等于所有作家都有义务完成所谓新闻目标。；B. It is contemptible for writers to be journalists.：与原文相反。二人以在日报发表文章为荣；term of contempt 是纽曼讽刺某些无人阅读的作家对新闻业的贬称。；C. Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism.：偷换结构。原文是纽曼“忍不住想定义 journalism”，不是作家容易受诱惑进入新闻业。
questions.evidence:
These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
"So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are.'"

questions.stem: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?
options: His music criticism may not appeal to readers today.
His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.
His style caters largely to modern specialists.
His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.
questions.explain:
正确项：His music criticism may not appeal to readers today. 作者认为卡杜斯评论复兴的希望渺茫，并明确说后现代读者不欣赏他那种华丽的时代文风，因此他的音乐评论如今可能无法吸引读者。
其他选项：B. His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.：无中生有。原文说他的音乐评论身份被遗忘，并未说其声誉长期存在争议。；C. His style caters largely to modern specialists.：与原文不符。只有专业人士知道他的音乐著述，不等于他的文风迎合现代专业人士；事实上现代读者不欣赏这种文风。；D. His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.：因果与主体错位。原文说业余评论传统整体衰退，不是说卡杜斯的作品背离这一传统。
questions.evidence:
The prospect seems remote.
Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.

questions.stem: What would be the best title for the text?
options: Newspapers of the Good Old Days
The Lost Horizon in Newspapers
Mournful Decline of Journalism
Prominent Critics in Memory
questions.explain:
正确项：The Lost Horizon in Newspapers 全文从报纸艺术评论不可逆的衰落写起，回顾昔日高水平评论传统，再以卡杜斯的被遗忘说明这一文化景观已经远去。The Lost Horizon 凝练概括了报纸中消失的艺术评论高地。
其他选项：A. Newspapers of the Good Old Days：范围过大且主题不准。文章怀念的是报纸艺术评论传统，不是全面介绍昔日报纸。；C. Mournful Decline of Journalism：范围扩大。文章只讨论艺术报道与艺术评论的衰退，并非整个新闻业的没落。；D. Prominent Critics in Memory：以偏概全。评论家和卡杜斯只是论证艺术评论衰落的材料，且文章强调他们被遗忘，而非追忆多位名家本身。
questions.evidence:
Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.

reading.title: Text 2
reading.en_title: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what …
reading.cn_title: 商业方法专利面临的司法收紧
reading.topic: 商业方法专利面临的司法收紧
reading.intro: 本篇主题：商业方法专利面临的司法收紧。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods. Amazon.com received one for its "one-click" online payment system. Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy. One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
paragraphs.zh: 过去十年间，已有数千项所谓的商业方法获得了专利授权。 亚马逊网站凭借其“一键式”在线支付系统获得了一项此类专利。 美林公司的一项资产配置策略也获得了法律保护。 甚至还有一位发明者为一种搬起箱子的技巧申请并取得了专利。

paragraphs.en: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago. In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents. *In re Bilski*, as the case is known, is "a very big deal," says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law. It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
paragraphs.zh: 如今，美国最高级别的专利法院似乎已经做好充分准备，要收紧商业方法专利的授权；这类专利自十年前首次获准以来就一直备受争议。 美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示，将借一宗特定案件对商业方法专利展开全面审查；这一举动已在知识产权律师中引发热议。 密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇说，这宗被称为“比尔斯基申请案”的案件“事关重大”。 它“有可能使整个这一类别的专利不复存在”。

paragraphs.en: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets. That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions. Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch. In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them. Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
paragraphs.zh: 限制商业方法专利申请将是一次彻底的立场逆转，因为正是联邦巡回上诉法院自己在 1998 年所谓的道富银行案判决中开创了此类专利，当时法院批准了一项汇集共同基金资产的方法专利。 该判决引发了商业方法专利申请的爆炸式增长；最初提出这些申请的是新兴互联网公司，它们试图抢先取得特定类型在线交易的专有权。 后来，根基更稳固的公司也争相把此类专利收入自己的专利储备，哪怕只是为了防守，以免竞争对手抢先一步。 2005 年，IBM 在一份法庭文件中指出，尽管它质疑授予商业方法专利的法律依据，自己却已获批 300 多项此类专利。 同样，一些华尔街投资公司一边用金融产品专利来武装自己，一边又在法庭案件中表态反对这种做法。

paragraphs.en: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market. The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.
paragraphs.zh: 比尔斯基案涉及一项申请中的专利，其内容是在能源市场对冲风险的方法。 联邦巡回上诉法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令，称该案将由法院全部 12 名法官共同审理，而不是由通常的三人合议庭审理；法院还要评估的一个问题是，是否应当“重新考虑”其在道富银行案中的判决。

paragraphs.en: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders. Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious. The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.
paragraphs.zh: 在最高法院近期一系列缩小专利权人保护范围的判决之后，联邦巡回上诉法院采取了上述行动。 例如，去年 4 月，大法官们发出明确信号：有太多专利仅仅因为一些显而易见的所谓“发明”而获得维持。 专利律师、乔治·华盛顿大学法学院教授哈罗德·C·韦格纳说，联邦巡回上诉法院的法官们正在“回应最高法院的反专利趋势”。

questions.stem: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of
options: their limited value to businesses.
their connection with asset allocation.
the possible restriction on their granting.
the controversy over their authorization.
questions.explain:
正确项：the possible restriction on their granting. 当前引发知识产权律师关注的是，最高级别的专利法院准备收紧商业方法专利，并将全面审查此类专利。scale back 对应授权可能受到限制。
其他选项：A. their limited value to businesses.：与原文不符。许多公司争相储备此类专利，文章没有说其商业价值有限。；B. their connection with asset allocation.：以例代因。资产配置只是美林专利的一个例子，不是近期担忧的原因。；D. the controversy over their authorization.：时间逻辑不符。授权争议自十年前就存在；近期关注来自法院可能采取的限制行动。
questions.evidence:
Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?
options: Its ruling complies with the court decisions.
It involves a very big business transaction.
It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.
It may change the legal practices in the U.S.
questions.explain:
正确项：It may change the legal practices in the U.S. 比尔斯基案可能使整个商业方法专利类别消失，并促使法院重新审视开创此类专利的旧判例，因而可能改变美国既有的专利法律实践。
其他选项：A. Its ruling complies with the court decisions.：时态错误且表意含混。案件尚未作出裁决，谈不上其判决与其他法院决定一致。；B. It involves a very big business transaction.：望文生义。a very big deal 意为案件影响重大，不是涉及一笔大型商业交易。；C. It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.：与原文相反。法院决定由全部 12 名法官审理，并未驳回该案。
questions.evidence:
It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.

questions.stem: The word "about-face" (Line 1, Para. 3) most probably means
options: loss of goodwill.
increase of hostility.
change of attitude.
enhancement of dignity.
questions.explain:
正确项：change of attitude. 该法院 1998 年亲自开创商业方法专利，如今却考虑限制它；前后立场相反，所以 about-face 指态度或政策转变。
其他选项：A. loss of goodwill.：无中生有。上下文没有讨论信誉或善意的丧失。；B. increase of hostility.：程度与含义均不符。原文强调方向逆转，不是敌意增加。；D. enhancement of dignity.：无中生有。上下文与尊严提升无关。
questions.evidence: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.

questions.stem: We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents
options: are immune to legal challenges.
are often unnecessarily issued.
lower the esteem for patent holders.
increase the incidence of risks.
questions.explain:
正确项：are often unnecessarily issued. 最高法院认为，许多显而易见、缺乏创新性的所谓“发明”也获得并维持了专利保护，这说明专利常被不必要地授予；该趋势正推动法院审查商业方法专利。
其他选项：A. are immune to legal challenges.：与原文相反。比尔斯基案和最高法院判决都在挑战、收缩相关专利保护。；C. lower the esteem for patent holders.：无中生有。原文谈保护范围和授权标准，不谈专利权人的社会声望。；D. increase the incidence of risks.：概念混淆。案件涉及能源风险对冲方法，但文章没有说商业方法专利会增加风险发生率。
questions.evidence: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the subject of the text?
options: A looming threat to business-method patents.
Protection for business-method patent holders.
A legal case regarding business-method patents.
A prevailing trend against business-method patents.
questions.explain:
正确项：A looming threat to business-method patents. 全文围绕一个迫近的威胁展开：联邦巡回上诉法院将借比尔斯基案重审旧判例，而该案甚至可能消除整类商业方法专利；looming threat 准确概括这种尚未落地但已逼近的风险。
其他选项：B. Protection for business-method patent holders.：与文章方向相反。全文讨论的是保护可能收缩，而非如何保护专利权人。；C. A legal case regarding business-method patents.：范围偏窄。比尔斯基案是切入点，核心在于它对整类商业方法专利造成的制度性威胁。；D. A prevailing trend against business-method patents.：概括不够准确。最高法院存在总体“反专利趋势”，但全文聚焦的是商业方法专利即将面临的特定司法审查，而非描述一个已经普遍形成的反对此类专利的潮流。
questions.evidence:
Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.

reading.title: Text 3
reading.en_title: In his book *The Tipping Point*, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social …
reading.cn_title: 社会流行现象中“意见领袖”的真实作用
reading.topic: 社会流行现象中“意见领袖”的真实作用
reading.intro: 本篇主题：社会流行现象中“意见领袖”的真实作用。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: In his book *The Tipping Point*, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected. The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread.
paragraphs.zh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在《引爆点》一书中提出，“社会流行潮”在很大程度上由极少数特殊人物的行动所推动；这些人通常被称为“意见领袖”，他们往往信息格外灵通、极具说服力或人脉广泛。 这一观点从直觉上看很有说服力，却没有解释观念究竟是如何传播的。

paragraphs.en: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else. Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them. The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods. In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention. Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
paragraphs.zh: 意见领袖之所以被认为重要，源自一种听起来合理却基本未经检验的理论，即“传播的两级流动”：信息先从媒体流向意见领袖，再由他们传给其他所有人。 营销人员欣然接受了两级传播理论，因为该理论表明，只要他们能找到并影响意见领袖，这些精心选中的人就会替他们完成大部分传播工作。 这一理论似乎还能解释某些造型、品牌或街区为何会突然出人意料地走红。 在许多这类案例中，只要粗略追寻一下原因，就会发现早在其他人注意到之前，已有一小群人在穿戴、推广或开发后来走红的东西。 这类个案式证据恰好与“只有某些特殊人物才能推动潮流”的观点吻合。

paragraphs.en: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed. In fact, they don't seem to be required at all.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一些研究人员在近期研究中发现，意见领袖对社会流行潮的影响远比人们通常认为的要小。 事实上，社会流行潮的形成似乎根本不需要他们。

paragraphs.en: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey - whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence - even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others. Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly. For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential. If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员的论证源于一个关于社会影响力的简单观察：除奥普拉·温弗里等少数名人之外，即便一个群体中最有影响力的人，实际交往的对象也没有那么多；而这些名人影响力格外巨大，主要是媒体作用的结果，并非人际交往影响的结果。 然而，按照两级传播理论，恰恰是这些并非名人的意见领袖被认为会直接影响朋友和同事，从而推动社会流行潮。 然而，要形成一场社会流行潮，每一个这样受到影响的人随后都必须影响自己的熟人，这些熟人又必须反过来影响他们各自的熟人，如此延续下去；而究竟还有多少人会听取这一传播链中每个人的意见，与最初那位意见领袖并没有多大关系。 例如，如果网络中与最初意见领袖仅隔两层关系的人表现出抵触，那么这股变化的连锁浪潮就不会传播很远，也不会影响很多人。

paragraphs.en: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced. They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades" - the widespread propagation of influence through networks - is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一人际影响的基本事实，研究人员进行了数千次群体计算机模拟，通过调整与人们影响他人的能力及其受他人影响倾向有关的多项变量，研究社会影响力的动态机制。 他们发现，形成所谓“全球级联效应”也就是影响力在网络中广泛传播的首要条件，并不是存在少数意见领袖，而是要有达到临界数量的大批容易受影响的人。

questions.stem: By citing the book *The Tipping Point*, the author intends to
options: analyze the consequences of social epidemics.
discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas.
exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.
describe the essential characteristics of influentials.
questions.explain:
正确项：discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas. 作者引用《引爆点》，是为引出“少数意见领袖推动社会流行、传播观念”的主张，随后全文围绕这种传播功能是否被夸大展开讨论。
其他选项：A. analyze the consequences of social epidemics.：对象错误。文章分析的是社会流行如何形成，不是它会造成什么后果。；C. exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.：断章取义。intuitively compelling 是作者对该观点吸引力的评价，不是引用此书的主要目的。；D. describe the essential characteristics of influentials.：以细节代主旨。信息灵通、善于说服、人脉广只是引介性描述，作者真正要讨论的是其传播作用。
questions.evidence: In his book *The Tipping Point*, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.

questions.stem: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory"
options: serves as a solution to marketing problems.
has helped explain certain prevalent trends.
has won support from influentials.
requires solid evidence for its validity.
questions.explain:
正确项：requires solid evidence for its validity. 作者明确称该理论“听起来合理但基本未经检验”，并指出现有支持只是个案式证据。这意味着它要被视为有效理论，还需要扎实、系统的证据。
其他选项：A. serves as a solution to marketing problems.：夸大作用。营销人员采纳该理论，是因为它似乎提供便利策略，不代表它已经解决营销问题。；B. has helped explain certain prevalent trends.：忽略作者保留语气。原文是 seems to explain，且紧接着指出证据只是个案，作者并未确认其解释有效。；C. has won support from influentials.：主体错位。采纳理论的是营销人员，不是意见领袖。
questions.evidence:
The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else.
Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.

questions.stem: What the researchers have observed recently shows that
options: the power of influence goes with social interactions.
interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.
influentials have more channels to reach the public.
most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.
questions.explain:
正确项：the power of influence goes with social interactions. 研究者观察到，除少数依靠媒体放大影响力的名人外，即便最有影响力者能直接交往的人也有限。这表明人际影响力的实际作用取决于社会交往以及后续互动链条。
其他选项：B. interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.：混淆两类影响。原文特意区分媒体影响与人际影响，没有说媒体会加强人际联系。；C. influentials have more channels to reach the public.：与原文相反。普通意见领袖直接接触的人其实不多。；D. most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.：范围扩大。原文只举少数名人为例，也不是研究观察的核心结论。
questions.evidence: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey - whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence - even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.

questions.stem: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who
options: stay outside the network of social influence.
have little contact with the source of influence.
are influenced and then influence others.
are influenced by the initial influential.
questions.explain:
正确项：are influenced and then influence others. 句中先说每个受影响者还必须继续影响自己的熟人，熟人再影响下一层。these people 概括的正是传播链上既受到上游影响、又继续影响下游的人。
其他选项：A. stay outside the network of social influence.：与原文相反。他们正是传播网络中的节点。；B. have little contact with the source of influence.：无中生有。原文关注的是逐层传播功能，不是与影响源接触多少。；D. are influenced by the initial influential.：范围过窄。传播链还包括第二层及更后面的受影响者，他们未必由最初意见领袖直接影响。
questions.evidence: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.

questions.stem: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
options: The eagerness to be accepted.
The impulse to influence others.
The readiness to be influenced.
The inclination to rely on others.
questions.explain:
正确项：The readiness to be influenced. 计算机模拟发现，大规模影响扩散的首要条件是存在临界数量的“容易受影响的人”。readiness to be influenced 正是对这一易受影响倾向的同义改写。
其他选项：A. The eagerness to be accepted.：概念偷换。“渴望被接纳”与“容易接受他人影响”并非同一心理倾向。；B. The impulse to influence others.：方向相反。结论强调受影响的倾向，不是主动影响别人的冲动。；D. The inclination to rely on others.：无中生有。依赖他人与接受观念传播不是一回事。
questions.evidence: They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades" - the widespread propagation of influence through networks - is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.

reading.title: Text 4
reading.en_title: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public. Beh…
reading.cn_title: 银行游说对会计准则制定独立性的侵蚀
reading.topic: 银行游说对会计准则制定独立性的侵蚀
reading.intro: 本篇主题：银行游说对会计准则制定独立性的侵蚀。先读题干，圈出关键词；回原文找证据句，再用主体、范围、方向排除。

paragraphs.en: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public. Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters. Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair. These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
paragraphs.zh: 银行家们一直公开把自身困境归咎于自己。 但在幕后，他们却一直把矛头对准别人，也就是会计准则制定者。 银行抱怨说，这些机构的规则迫使它们报告巨额亏损，这实在不公平。 这些规则要求银行按照第三方实际愿意支付的价格为部分资产估值，而不能按照管理者和监管者希望这些资产卖到的价格估值。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, banks' lobbying now seems to be working. The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised. And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 不幸的是，银行的游说如今似乎正在奏效。 具体内情或许无从得知，但准则制定者的独立性正在受损，而这种独立性对于资本市场正常运行至关重要。 而且，除非银行按足以吸引买家的价格在账面上计列有毒资产，否则银行体系将很难恢复运转。

paragraphs.en: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America's Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes. These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements. Bob Herz, the FASB's chairman, cried out against those who "question our motives." Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by management."
paragraphs.zh: 在与国会经历一场激烈而受挫的交锋后，美国财务会计准则委员会迅速通过了规则修改。 这些修改让银行在使用模型评估非流动资产价值时拥有更大自由，也让它们在利润表中确认长期资产损失时拥有更大灵活性。 美国财务会计准则委员会主席鲍勃·赫兹强烈抗议那些“质疑我们动机”的人。 然而，银行股价随之上涨，而且这些修改强化了某游说团体委婉所称的“管理层判断的运用”。

paragraphs.en: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise. The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong. Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
paragraphs.zh: 欧洲各国部长随即要求国际会计准则理事会也采取同样行动。 国际会计准则理事会表示，它不愿在缺乏整体规划的情况下贸然行动；但当它在今年晚些时候完成规则重构时，迫使它屈服的压力将十分强大。 欧盟委员查理·麦克里维警告国际会计准则理事会，它并非“生活在政治真空中”，而是“身处现实世界”，并称欧洲仍可能另行制定不同的规则。

paragraphs.en: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets. Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts. The truth will not be known for years. But banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical. And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
paragraphs.zh: 真正脱离现实的恰恰是银行，因为它们的账目严重高估了资产价值。 如今银行辩称，市场价格夸大了损失，因为这些价格主要反映市场暂时缺乏流动性，而非坏账最终可能达到的规模。 事实真相还要多年后才能揭晓。 但银行股票的交易价格低于每股账面价值，这表明投资者对此持怀疑态度。 而市场交易停滞，部分原因正是银行陷入瘫痪：它们害怕在账面上确认损失而不肯出售资产，却又不愿买入那些据称十分便宜的资产。

paragraphs.en: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with. America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive. Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters. The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests. But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
paragraphs.zh: 要让这一体系重新运转，就必须确认并处理损失。 除非银行把资产减记到买家认为有吸引力的价位，否则美国收购有毒资产的新计划不会奏效。 运转成功的市场需要独立自主、甚至敢于据理力争的准则制定者。 美国财务会计准则委员会和国际会计准则理事会一直正是这样的机构；例如，它们曾顶住特殊利益集团的敌意，整顿有关股票期权和养老金的规则。 但如今它们一旦向批评者让步，就等于招致更多压力，迫使自己作出更多妥协。

questions.stem: Bankers complained that they were forced to
options: follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules.
collect payments from third parties.
cooperate with the price managers.
reevaluate some of their assets.
questions.explain:
正确项：follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules. 银行抱怨准则迫使它们按第三方愿付的市场价格评估资产并报告巨额损失，认为这些资产估值规则对自己不利。unfavorable asset evaluation rules 概括了其抱怨对象。
其他选项：B. collect payments from third parties.：曲解 the price a third party would pay。第三方愿付价格是估值基准，不是银行被迫向第三方收款。；C. cooperate with the price managers.：拆词拼凑。原文的 managers 是希望资产卖得更高的管理者，并不存在 price managers 这一主体。；D. reevaluate some of their assets.：概括不完整且偏离抱怨重点。原文强调被迫遵循特定的市场价格估值规则并确认巨额损失，不只是泛泛“重新评估资产”。
questions.evidence:
Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair.
These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.

questions.stem: According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in
options: the diminishing role of management.
the revival of the banking system.
the banks' long-term asset losses.
the weakening of its independence.
questions.explain:
正确项：the weakening of its independence. FASB 在国会和银行压力下匆忙修改规则，扩大了管理层裁量；作者明确说准则制定者的独立性正受损，而且当前让步会招致更多让步压力。
其他选项：A. the diminishing role of management.：与原文相反。修改增强了管理层使用主观判断的空间。；B. the revival of the banking system.：因果倒置。作者认为若资产不降到吸引买家的价格，银行体系仍难复苏；放宽规则本身不能带来复苏。；C. the banks' long-term asset losses.：偷换结果。修改让银行在确认长期资产损失时更灵活，并不是导致损失本身。
questions.evidence:
The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by management."
But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to
options: keep away from political influences.
evade the pressure from their peers.
act on their own in rule-setting.
take gradual measures in reform.
questions.explain:
正确项：act on their own in rule-setting. IASB 不愿脱离整体规划仓促跟随美国，而麦克里维以“不能生活在政治真空中”和欧洲可能另立规则相威胁，反对的正是 IASB 依据自身程序和专业判断独立制定规则。
其他选项：A. keep away from political influences.：表述过于泛化。保持独立是准则机构的制度属性，但本段冲突的具体对象是 IASB 不按欧洲部长要求立即跟进、试图自主安排规则制定。；B. evade the pressure from their peers.：主体错误。压力来自欧洲部长等政治力量，不是 IASB 的同业伙伴。；D. take gradual measures in reform.：无中生有。overall planning 指按整体方案制定规则，并未说采取渐进式改革措施。
questions.evidence:
The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.

questions.stem: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they
options: misinterpreted market price indicators.
exaggerated the real value of their assets.
neglected the likely existence of bad debts.
denied booking losses in their sale of assets.
questions.explain:
正确项：exaggerated the real value of their assets. 定位句直接说明银行账目 vastly overvalued assets，即把资产账面价值估得远高于其真实市场价值，正对应“夸大资产的实际价值”。
其他选项：A. misinterpreted market price indicators.：偷换作者判断。银行声称市场价格夸大损失，但作者批评的是其账目高估资产，不只是误读某个价格指标。；C. neglected the likely existence of bad debts.：无直接依据。原文说银行认为价格反映流动性而非坏账规模，没有说它们忽略坏账可能存在。；D. denied booking losses in their sale of assets.：行为关系错误。银行因害怕确认损失而不肯出售资产，不是在出售后否认记账损失。
questions.evidence: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.

questions.stem: The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of
options: satisfaction.
skepticism.
objectiveness.
sympathy.
questions.explain:
正确项：sympathy. 作者认为准则制定者的独立性对资本市场至关重要，肯定 FASB 和 IASB 曾顶住利益集团压力整顿规则，并担忧它们如今被迫让步。对其处境和使命表现出明显支持与同情。
其他选项：A. satisfaction.：与原文不符。作者对独立性受损和当前让步深感不满，不能说态度是满意。；B. skepticism.：主体错位。作者怀疑的是银行对资产价值的说法，不是怀疑准则制定者的价值。；C. objectiveness.：态度不够准确。作者使用 Unfortunately、essential 等评价词并公开主张维护其独立性，立场并非中性客观。
questions.evidence:
The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters.
The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.

sentences.en: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
sentences.core: the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline。
sentences.structure: Of all the changes... 限定比较范围；that have taken place... 修饰 changes；in the scope and seriousness... 说明衰退体现在哪两个方面。
sentences.key: coverage：常见义为“覆盖”；此处指媒体对某一领域的“报道”。；scope：此处不是具体的“范围界线”，而是艺术报道所涉及内容的广度。；far-reaching：影响深远的。；inexorable decline：无法阻止、难以逆转的衰退。
sentences.zh: 在过去四分之一个世纪里，英语报纸经历了种种变化，其中影响最为深远的，或许就是艺术报道在覆盖范围和严肃程度上不可阻挡的衰退。
sentences.tip: their 指 English-language newspapers；作者说的是艺术报道的广度与严肃性下降，不是所有新闻业都消失。

sentences.en: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers.
sentences.core: It is difficult for the average reader to imagine a time。
sentences.structure: It 是形式主语，真正主语是 to imagine...；under the age of forty 修饰 reader；when... 修饰 a time。
sentences.key: to the point of：达到……的程度。；arts criticism：艺术评论，而非泛指对艺术的“批评”。
sentences.zh: 对普通的 40 岁以下读者来说，要想象多数大城市报纸都能读到高质量艺术评论的年代，几乎是不可能的。
sentences.tip: 年轻读者是无法想象过去曾有这种盛况，并非怀疑艺术评论是否适合刊登。

sentences.en: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
sentences.core: To read such books is to marvel at the fact。
sentences.structure: 两个不定式分别作主语和表语；that... 是 the fact 的同位语从句；deem A suitable for B 的被动形式为 A be deemed suitable for B。
sentences.key: learned：此处读作 /ˈlɜːnɪd/，作形容词，意为“学术性强的、博学的”，不是动词 learn 的过去式。；marvel at：对……感到惊叹。；general-circulation daily：面向普通大众发行的日报。
sentences.zh: 今天读到这样的书，人们不免惊叹：其中那些学术性很强的内容，竟曾被认为适合刊登在面向大众发行的日报上。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
sentences.core: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews。
sentences.structure: published in England... 修饰 reviews；at a time 与前面的历史时期同位衔接；when... 修饰 time；in which it appeared 修饰 publications。
sentences.key: unfocused：此处不是“注意力不集中”，而是指评论题材不受严格限制、主题自由。；ornament：本义为“装饰品”；此处比喻能提升刊物品位和吸引力的内容。；be removed from：与……相隔遥远；此处强调时代和阅读经验上的距离。；the turn of the 20th century：19 世纪与 20 世纪之交。
sentences.zh: 而我们与另一种传统的距离甚至更远：从 20 世纪之交到第二次世界大战前夕，英国报纸曾刊登主题不受拘束的评论；当时新闻纸便宜得很，文笔优雅的艺术评论被视为给刊物增光添彩的点缀。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
sentences.core: it was taken for granted that the critics would write...。
sentences.structure: it 是形式宾语转化后的形式主语；that... 承载真正内容；they covered 修饰 events。
sentences.key: take it for granted that...：想当然地认为……；把……视为理所当然。；in detail and at length：详尽而充分地。
sentences.zh: 在那个久远的年代，人们理所当然地认为，大报评论家会对自己报道的事件作细致而充分的论述。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about.
sentences.core: Theirs was a serious business, and reviewers could be trusted。
sentences.structure: Theirs 相当于 Their work；who wore... 修饰 reviewers；like... 举例；to know... 是 be trusted 后的不定式补足语；what... 作 know 的宾语。
sentences.key: business：此处意为“要认真对待的事务、事业”，不是商业买卖。；wear one's learning lightly：字面为“轻松地带着学问”，实际指虽学识渊博却不卖弄。；know what one is about：清楚自己在做什么或谈什么，精通本行。
sentences.zh: 评论对他们而言是一项严肃的事业；即便像萧伯纳和欧内斯特·纽曼那样不刻意炫耀学问的评论家，也完全可以让人相信他们深知自己在谈什么。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: "So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are.'"
sentences.core: So few authors have... that I am tempted to define...。
sentences.structure: so few... that... 表示“如此少……以至于……”；applied by A to B 修饰 a term of contempt；who are not read 和 who are 分别修饰两类作家，末尾省略了 read。
sentences.key: read：此处是被动意义，writers who are read 指“作品有人读的作家”。；keep one's own end up：并非“把自己的一端抬起来”，而是指在竞争或困难中不落下风、站稳脚跟。
sentences.zh: 纽曼写道：“有足够才智或文学天赋、能够在新闻写作中站稳脚跟的作家少之又少，以至于我忍不住想把‘新闻业’定义为：那些无人问津的作家用来贬低那些拥有读者的作家的一个词。”
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Neville Cardus, who wrote for the *Manchester Guardian* from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket.
sentences.core: Neville Cardus is now known solely as a writer。
sentences.structure: who wrote... 是非限制性定语从句，补充其职业经历；until shortly before... 表示写作一直持续到去世前不久；on the game of cricket 修饰 essays。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 内维尔·卡杜斯从 1917 年起一直为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿，直到 1975 年去世前不久；如今人们只知道他是一位板球随笔作家。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his *Autobiography* (1947) became a best-seller.
sentences.core: he was one of the critics, and a stylist。
sentences.structure: so widely admired that... 是 so...that... 结果结构，修饰 a stylist；though 表示与他今日被遗忘的处境形成转折。
sentences.key: stylist：此处不是“造型师”，而是指文风卓越、善于遣词行文的作家。
sentences.zh: 然而在世时，他还是英国最杰出的古典音乐评论家之一，也是一位广受推崇的文体家，就连他 1947 年出版的《自传》都成了畅销书。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
sentences.core: tastes had changed, and readers have little use for the prose。
sentences.structure: long before his death 说明变化很早发生；richly upholstered 修饰 prose；in which he specialized 修饰这种文体。
sentences.key: have little use for：不是“很少用到”，而是“不欣赏、不需要，对……不感兴趣”。；upholstered：本义为“装有软垫的”；此处比喻文字铺陈华丽、修饰繁复。；Vicwardian：由 Victorian 与 Edwardian 合成，指兼具维多利亚时代和爱德华时代特征的风格。
sentences.zh: 早在他去世之前，新闻写作的审美趣味就已经改变；后现代读者也不欣赏他所擅长的那种辞藻华美、兼具维多利亚与爱德华时代风格的散文。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
sentences.core: the nation's top patent court appears ready to scale back on business-method patents。
sentences.structure: which... 是非限制性定语从句，补充说明商业方法专利长期存在争议；ever since... 表示争议从十年前持续至今。
sentences.key: scale back on：此处不是按比例缩小物体，而是“削减、收紧、限制”。；the nation's top patent court：指后文的美国联邦巡回上诉法院，而非美国最高法院。
sentences.zh: 如今，美国最高级别的专利法院似乎已经做好充分准备，要收紧商业方法专利的授权；这类专利自十年前首次获准以来就一直备受争议。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents.
sentences.core: the U.S. Court of Appeals... said it would use a case to conduct a review。
sentences.structure: In a move... 概括法院举措；that has...abuzz 修饰 move；it would... 是省略 that 的宾语从句。
sentences.key: move：此处意为一项“行动、举措”，不是移动。；abuzz：议论纷纷的，充满兴奋或关注的。
sentences.zh: 美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示，将借一宗特定案件对商业方法专利展开全面审查；这一举动已在知识产权律师中引发热议。
sentences.tip: it 指法院；该案是法院重新审视整类专利的载体，不只是普通商业纠纷。

sentences.en: It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
sentences.core: It has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents。
sentences.structure: 见原句
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 它“有可能使整个这一类别的专利不复存在”。
sentences.tip: It 指比尔斯基案；an entire class 指商业方法专利这一整类专利，体现其可能带来的制度性改变。

sentences.en: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
sentences.core: Curbs would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit that introduced such patents。
sentences.structure: it was...that... 是强调句，突出当年正是该法院引入此类专利；with its 1998 decision... 说明方式和时间；approving... 补充该判决的具体内容。
sentences.key: claim：在专利语境中指专利申请中的“权利要求”，这里可概括为商业方法专利申请。；about-face：本义为军事口令“向后转”；此处比喻态度或政策发生 180 度转变。；pool：此处作动词，意为“集中、汇集”资金或资产。；curbs on：对……的限制。
sentences.zh: 限制商业方法专利申请将是一次彻底的立场逆转，因为正是联邦巡回上诉法院自己在 1998 年所谓的道富银行案判决中开创了此类专利，当时法院批准了一项汇集共同基金资产的方法专利。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
sentences.core: That ruling produced an explosion in filings。
sentences.structure: initially by... 说明最初申请者；trying to... 修饰 companies，说明其目的；to specific types... 修饰 exclusive rights。
sentences.key: filing：此处指正式提交的专利“申请”，不是普通文件归档。；stake out：本义为划定地界；此处指抢先占据并确立专属权利。
sentences.zh: 该判决引发了商业方法专利申请的爆炸式增长；最初提出这些申请的是新兴互联网公司，它们试图抢先取得特定类型在线交易的专有权。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
sentences.core: companies raced to add such patents to their files。
sentences.structure: more established 表示经营更成熟；if only as... 补充最低限度的动机；that might... 修饰 rivals。
sentences.key: file：此处指公司持有的专利组合或档案，不是单个文件。；if only：此处意为“哪怕只是”，说明一个最低限度但足够成立的目的。；beat someone to the punch：抢在某人前面行动、先下手为强。
sentences.zh: 后来，根基更稳固的公司也争相把此类专利收入自己的专利储备，哪怕只是为了防守，以免竞争对手抢先一步。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them.
sentences.core: IBM noted that it had been issued more than 300 patents。
sentences.structure: 第一个 it 指 IBM；despite the fact that... 表示让步，其中 them 指商业方法专利。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 2005 年，IBM 在一份法庭文件中指出，尽管它质疑授予商业方法专利的法律依据，自己却已获批 300 多项此类专利。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.
sentences.core: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order。
sentences.structure: stating 引出命令的两项内容，两个 that 从句并列；第一个从句包含 rather than... 对比；第二个从句中 it wants to evaluate 修饰 one issue，whether... 作表语。
sentences.key: hear a case：法律语境中指“审理案件”，不是单纯听取。；panel：此处指由若干法官组成的合议庭。
sentences.zh: 联邦巡回上诉法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令，称该案将由法院全部 12 名法官共同审理，而不是由通常的三人合议庭审理；法院还要评估的一个问题是，是否应当“重新考虑”其在道富银行案中的判决。
sentences.tip: 案件尚在由全体法官审理，法院是在考虑是否推翻旧判例，并非已经作出判决或驳回案件。

sentences.en: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
sentences.core: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of decisions。
sentences.structure: by the Supreme Court 修饰 decisions；that has narrowed... 从语法形式上承接单数中心词 a series，说明这一系列判决的共同效果。
sentences.key: in the wake of：紧随……而来；作为……的结果或后续。；narrow the scope of protections：缩小保护范围。
sentences.zh: 在最高法院近期一系列缩小专利权人保护范围的判决之后，联邦巡回上诉法院采取了上述行动。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious.
sentences.core: the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld。
sentences.structure: that... 作 signaled 的宾语；for "inventions" 说明专利所保护的对象；that are obvious 修饰 inventions；引号暗示作者质疑这些东西是否配称为发明。
sentences.key: uphold：法律语境中指法院“维持”原决定或权利的有效性。；obvious：专利法中“显而易见”意味着缺乏足够创新性，通常不应获得专利保护。
sentences.zh: 例如，去年 4 月，大法官们发出明确信号：有太多专利仅仅因为一些显而易见的所谓“发明”而获得维持。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.
sentences.core: The judges are reacting to the anti-patent trend, says Harold C. Wegner。
sentences.structure: 句末 a patent attorney and professor... 与人名同位，补充其身份；at the Supreme Court 指这一趋势体现在最高法院的判决中。
sentences.key: scale back on：削减、收紧。；have the potential to：有可能……。；a dramatic about-face：彻底的立场逆转。；stake out exclusive rights：抢先确立专有权。
sentences.zh: 专利律师、乔治·华盛顿大学法学院教授哈罗德·C·韦格纳说，联邦巡回上诉法院的法官们正在“回应最高法院的反专利趋势”。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In his book *The Tipping Point*, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.
sentences.core: Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven by the actions of individuals。
sentences.structure: that... 是 argues 的宾语从句；often called influentials 是过去分词短语，补充说明 individuals；who... 继续修饰这些特殊人物；三个形容词并列描述其特点。
sentences.key: epidemic：常见义为“流行病”；social epidemics 用疾病传播作比喻，指观念、风尚或行为在社会中的迅速流行。；influential：通常作形容词“有影响力的”；此处名词化，指“意见领袖、有影响力的人”。；in large part：在很大程度上。；well connected：人脉广泛的、社会关系良好的。
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在《引爆点》一书中提出，“社会流行潮”在很大程度上由极少数特殊人物的行动所推动；这些人通常被称为“意见领袖”，他们往往信息格外灵通、极具说服力或人脉广泛。
sentences.tip: 本句介绍的是格拉德威尔的观点，不等于本文作者最终赞同这一观点。

sentences.en: The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread.
sentences.core: The idea is compelling, but it doesn't explain...。
sentences.structure: 见原句
sentences.key: compelling：此处意为“有说服力的、令人信服的”，不是“强迫性的”。
sentences.zh: 这一观点从直觉上看很有说服力，却没有解释观念究竟是如何传播的。
sentences.tip: it 指前句“少数意见领袖推动社会流行”的观点。

sentences.en: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else.
sentences.core: The supposed importance derives from a theory: Information flows...。
sentences.structure: called... 修饰 theory；冒号后具体解释理论内容；from the media to... and from them to... 是两个并列的传播阶段。
sentences.key: supposed：此处带保留意味，指“所谓的、被认为存在的”，暗示其重要性尚未得到证实。；derive from：源自、来自。；plausible-sounding：听起来似乎合理的。；largely untested：基本未经验证的。
sentences.zh: 意见领袖之所以被认为重要，源自一种听起来合理却基本未经检验的理论，即“传播的两级流动”：信息先从媒体流向意见领袖，再由他们传给其他所有人。
sentences.tip: them 指 the influentials；plausible-sounding 不等于已被可靠证据证实，真正落点在 largely untested。

sentences.en: Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them.
sentences.core: Marketers have embraced the flow because it suggests that people will do the work。
sentences.structure: because 引导原因状语从句；that... 作 suggests 的宾语；其中 if... 是条件从句，those select people... 是主句。
sentences.key: embrace：常见义为“拥抱”；此处意为“欣然接受、采纳”一种理论。；select：此处作形容词，意为“经过挑选的、少数优选的”。
sentences.zh: 营销人员欣然接受了两级传播理论，因为该理论表明，只要他们能找到并影响意见领袖，这些精心选中的人就会替他们完成大部分传播工作。
sentences.tip: 营销人员喜欢该理论，只能说明它实用且诱人，不能证明它真实有效。

sentences.en: In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention.
sentences.core: a cursory search finds that some group was wearing, promoting, or developing...。
sentences.structure: that... 作 finds 的宾语；三个现在分词并列；whatever it is 作三个动作的共同宾语；before... 表示这群人行动早于大众关注。
sentences.key: cursory：粗略的、走马观花的。；whatever it is：泛指当时讨论的任何流行对象，不必机械译成“无论它是什么”。
sentences.zh: 在许多这类案例中，只要粗略追寻一下原因，就会发现早在其他人注意到之前，已有一小群人在穿戴、推广或开发后来走红的东西。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
sentences.core: Anecdotal evidence fits with the idea。
sentences.structure: that... 是 the idea 的同位语从句，说明该观点的内容。
sentences.key: anecdotal evidence：来自个别案例或传闻的证据，通常缺乏系统验证。；fit nicely with：与……看似十分吻合；结合上下文含有“容易迎合该理论但证明力不足”的意味。
sentences.zh: 这类个案式证据恰好与“只有某些特殊人物才能推动潮流”的观点吻合。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
sentences.core: researchers have come up with the finding。
sentences.structure: that... 是 finding 的同位语从句；than is generally supposed 是比较结构，补足“比通常设想的影响小得多”。
sentences.key: come up with the finding that...：得出……的研究发现。；far less... than...：远不如……。
sentences.zh: 然而，一些研究人员在近期研究中发现，意见领袖对社会流行潮的影响远比人们通常认为的要小。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey - whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence - even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
sentences.core: The argument stems from an observation: even the most influential members don't interact with that many others。
sentences.structure: 冒号后给出观察内容；With the exception of... 排除少数媒体名人；两个破折号之间的 whose... 修饰 celebrities；not interpersonal 与 media 对比。
sentences.key: outsize：超常的、格外巨大的。；a function of：此处不是数学“函数”，而是“由……造成的结果、取决于……”。；that many：那么多；that 作程度副词。
sentences.zh: 研究人员的论证源于一个关于社会影响力的简单观察：除奥普拉·温弗里等少数名人之外，即便一个群体中最有影响力的人，实际交往的对象也没有那么多；而这些名人影响力格外巨大，主要是媒体作用的结果，并非人际交往影响的结果。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
sentences.core: it is these non-celebrity influentials who are supposed to drive social epidemics。
sentences.structure: it is...who... 是强调句，突出非名人意见领袖；according to... 是插入语；by influencing... 说明理论设想中的推动方式。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 然而，按照两级传播理论，恰恰是这些并非名人的意见领袖被认为会直接影响朋友和同事，从而推动社会流行潮。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
sentences.core: each person must influence acquaintances; and how many others pay attention has little to do with the initial influential。
sentences.structure: For a social epidemic to occur 是目的兼条件背景；who... 修饰 acquaintances；theirs 省略重复名词，等于 their own acquaintances；分号后 how many... 是主语从句。
sentences.key: so affected：如此受到影响的；so 回指前句“受非名人意见领袖直接影响”这一方式。；in turn：继而、依次、转而。
sentences.zh: 然而，要形成一场社会流行潮，每一个这样受到影响的人随后都必须影响自己的熟人，这些熟人又必须反过来影响他们各自的熟人，如此延续下去；而究竟还有多少人会听取这一传播链中每个人的意见，与最初那位意见领袖并没有多大关系。
sentences.tip: these people 并非只指第一批受意见领袖影响的人，而是指传播链中那些“先受影响、再影响别人”的各层传播者，对应 Q34 的 C 项。

sentences.en: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
sentences.core: If people prove resistant, the cascade won't propagate or affect many people。
sentences.structure: in the network 和 two degrees removed... 都修饰 people；propagate 与 affect 并列。
sentences.key: two degrees removed from：与……相隔两层社会关系，而非“被移走两度”。；cascade：本义为“瀑布”；此处指层层传递的连锁变化。；propagate：传播、扩散。
sentences.zh: 例如，如果网络中与最初意见领袖仅隔两层关系的人表现出抵触，那么这股变化的连锁浪潮就不会传播很远，也不会影响很多人。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
sentences.core: the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence。
sentences.structure: Building on... 说明研究基础；by conducting... 说明研究方式；manipulating... 表示模拟过程中伴随的变量调整；relating to... 修饰 variables，后接两个并列对象 ability 和 tendency。
sentences.key: build on：在……基础上进一步发展或研究。；manipulate variables：在实验中有控制地调整变量，不含“暗中操纵”的贬义。
sentences.zh: 基于这一人际影响的基本事实，研究人员进行了数千次群体计算机模拟，通过调整与人们影响他人的能力及其受他人影响倾向有关的多项变量，研究社会影响力的动态机制。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades" - the widespread propagation of influence through networks - is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
sentences.core: They found that the principal requirement is the presence of a critical mass。
sentences.structure: that... 是宾语从句；for what is called... 修饰 requirement，其中 what 表示“所谓的事物”；两个破折号之间解释 global cascades；not of A but, rather, of B 修饰 presence，突出真正需要的是 B。
sentences.key: critical mass：本义为核反应的“临界质量”；此处指足以触发大规模连锁传播的最低必要人数。；in large part：在很大程度上。；intuitively compelling：直觉上很有说服力。；derive from：源自。
sentences.zh: 他们发现，形成所谓“全球级联效应”也就是影响力在网络中广泛传播的首要条件，并不是存在少数意见领袖，而是要有达到临界数量的大批容易受影响的人。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair.
sentences.core: Their rules have forced them to report enormous losses, and it is not fair。
sentences.structure: moan the banks 是倒装的插入性引语，相当于 the banks complain；Their 指准则制定者，them 指银行。
sentences.key: moan：本义为“呻吟”；此处指带有不满地“抱怨”。
sentences.zh: 银行抱怨说，这些机构的规则迫使它们报告巨额亏损，这实在不公平。
sentences.tip: 这是银行的抱怨，不代表作者认同“不公平”的判断。

sentences.en: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
sentences.core: These rules say they must value some assets at the price, not the price。
sentences.structure: 两个 price 后都省略关系词，分别由 a third party would pay 和 managers and regulators would like them to fetch 修饰；not 构成实际市场价与管理层期望价的对比。
sentences.key: say：此处主语是规则，意为“规定、要求”。；fetch：常见义为“取来”；用于价格时意为“售得、卖得某一价格”。
sentences.zh: 这些规则要求银行按照第三方实际愿意支付的价格为部分资产估值，而不能按照管理者和监管者希望这些资产卖到的价格估值。
sentences.tip: they 指银行，them 指部分资产；规则的核心是按第三方愿付的市场价格估值。

sentences.en: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
sentences.core: The details may be unknowable, but the independence is being compromised。
sentences.structure: essential to... 是插入性的形容词短语，补充说明 independence 的重要性。
sentences.key: compromise：常见义为“妥协”；此处作被动，意为“受到损害、被削弱”。
sentences.zh: 具体内情或许无从得知，但准则制定者的独立性正在受损，而这种独立性对于资本市场正常运行至关重要。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
sentences.core: unless banks carry assets at prices, reviving the banking system will be difficult。
sentences.structure: unless 引导必要条件；that attract buyers 修饰 prices；动名词短语 reviving... 作主语。
sentences.key: carry：常见义为“携带”；会计语境中指以某一价值在账面上“列示、计列”资产。；toxic asset：有毒资产，指价值大幅缩水、难以出售且风险很高的资产。
sentences.zh: 而且，除非银行按足以吸引买家的价格在账面上计列有毒资产，否则银行体系将很难恢复运转。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements.
sentences.core: These gave banks more freedom and more flexibility。
sentences.structure: These 指规则修改；两个并列宾语分别由 to use... 和 in recognizing... 具体说明；in their income statements 修饰损失确认。
sentences.key: illiquid asset：流动性不足、难以迅速按合理价格出售的资产。；recognize losses：会计语境中指在报表中“确认损失”。
sentences.zh: 这些修改让银行在使用模型评估非流动资产价值时拥有更大自由，也让它们在利润表中确认长期资产损失时拥有更大灵活性。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by management."
sentences.core: bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one group calls...。
sentences.structure: what...calls... 是宾语从句，等于“该团体所称的东西”；Yet 将主席对动机受质疑的抗议与规则明显有利于银行的结果对照。
sentences.key: judgment：此处指管理层在资产估值和损失确认上的主观裁量。；politely calls：字面是“礼貌地称为”，实际暗示这是一种粉饰性、委婉的说法。
sentences.zh: 然而，银行股价随之上涨，而且这些修改强化了某游说团体委婉所称的“管理层判断的运用”。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
sentences.core: 见结构
sentences.structure: demand that...do... 中从句使用动词原形 do，是表示要求的虚拟语气。
sentences.key: do likewise：照样做、采取同样措施，此处指仿照美国放宽会计规则。
sentences.zh: 欧洲各国部长随即要求国际会计准则理事会也采取同样行动。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
sentences.core: The IASB says..., but the pressure is strong。
sentences.structure: it does not want... 是省略 that 的宾语从句；to fold 修饰 pressure；when... 说明压力可能迫使其让步的时间。
sentences.key: fold：常见义为“折叠”；此处指在压力下“屈服、让步”。；reconstruction of rules：对规则体系的重构，而非建筑物重建。
sentences.zh: 国际会计准则理事会表示，它不愿在缺乏整体规划的情况下贸然行动；但当它在今年晚些时候完成规则重构时，迫使它屈服的压力将十分强大。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
sentences.core: Charlie McCreevy warned the IASB that it did not live... and that Europe could develop different rules。
sentences.structure: 两个 that 从句并列，都是 warned 的内容；第一个从句内 not...but... 对比政治真空与现实世界；a European commissioner 与人名同位。
sentences.key: vacuum：本义为“真空”；political vacuum 指不受政治环境和压力影响的状态。；yet：此处意为“仍然、到头来仍有可能”，不是转折连词。
sentences.zh: 欧盟委员查理·麦克里维警告国际会计准则理事会，它并非“生活在政治真空中”，而是“身处现实世界”，并称欧洲仍可能另行制定不同的规则。
sentences.tip: 警告和另立规则的威胁表明，麦克里维反对 IASB 独立按照自己的程序与判断制定规则，对应 Q38 的“act on their own in rule-setting”。

sentences.en: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.
sentences.core: It was banks that were on the wrong planet。
sentences.structure: It was...that... 是强调句，突出真正脱离现实的是银行；with accounts... 说明判断依据；that... 修饰 accounts。
sentences.key: on the wrong planet：字面为“在错误的星球上”，此处讽刺银行脱离市场现实。；account：此处指银行账目或财务报表，不是普通“账户”。
sentences.zh: 真正脱离现实的恰恰是银行，因为它们的账目严重高估了资产价值。
sentences.tip: overvalued assets 指账面价值高于真实价值，对应“夸大资产的实际价值”。

sentences.en: Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts.
sentences.core: they argue that market prices overstate losses。
sentences.structure: because... 给出银行的理由；其中 they 指 market prices；not... 与 the temporary illiquidity 对比。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 如今银行辩称，市场价格夸大了损失，因为这些价格主要反映市场暂时缺乏流动性，而非坏账最终可能达到的规模。
sentences.tip: 整句仍是在转述银行立场，作者下一句说真相多年后才会知道，并未直接接受这一辩护。

sentences.en: But banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
sentences.core: banks' shares trade below their book value。
sentences.structure: suggesting... 是现在分词短语，说明低于账面价值这一市场现象传递出的信号。
sentences.key: book value：账面价值，即资产负债表所记录的净资产价值，不是“书的价值”。
sentences.zh: 但银行股票的交易价格低于每股账面价值，这表明投资者对此持怀疑态度。
sentences.tip: 投资者怀疑的正是银行账面资产估值及其关于损失被夸大的说法。

sentences.en: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
sentences.core: dead markets reflect the paralysis of banks。
sentences.structure: which... 修饰 banks；will not sell... 与 are reluctant to buy... 由 yet 连接，构成矛盾；for fear of... 说明不卖的原因。
sentences.key: dead market：交易活动几乎停滞、缺乏流动性的市场。；book a loss：把损失记入账目、确认损失。；bargain：此处指价格低廉、值得买入的资产。
sentences.zh: 而市场交易停滞，部分原因正是银行陷入瘫痪：它们害怕在账面上确认损失而不肯出售资产，却又不愿买入那些据称十分便宜的资产。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with.
sentences.core: losses must be recognized and dealt with。
sentences.structure: To get the system working again 是目的状语；get + 宾语 + 现在分词 表示使体系恢复运行。
sentences.key: 见下方词汇笔记
sentences.zh: 要让这一体系重新运转，就必须确认并处理损失。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.
sentences.core: The plan will not work unless banks mark assets to levels。
sentences.structure: to buy up... 修饰 plan；unless 引导必要条件；which buyers find attractive 修饰 levels，其中 attractive 是宾语补足语。
sentences.key: mark assets to levels：按某一价位重新标记或计量资产价值，语境中指将账面估值调整到市场可接受水平。；buy up：大量收购、全部或集中买入。
sentences.zh: 除非银行把资产减记到买家认为有吸引力的价位，否则美国收购有毒资产的新计划不会奏效。
sentences.tip: 先找谓语，再拆从句；把修饰语挂回它修饰的词。

sentences.en: The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.
sentences.core: The FASB and IASB have been exactly that。
sentences.structure: that 指前句“独立甚至敢于抗争的准则制定者”；cleaning up... 补充其具体作为；against hostility... 表示在利益集团敌视下仍坚持行动。
sentences.key: special interests：特殊利益集团，即试图让政策服务于自身利益的组织或行业力量。；clean up rules：清理、整顿和完善规则。
sentences.zh: 美国财务会计准则委员会和国际会计准则理事会一直正是这样的机构；例如，它们曾顶住特殊利益集团的敌意，整顿有关股票期权和养老金的规则。
sentences.tip: 作者在肯定两机构过去维护独立性的表现，为判断其态度提供直接依据。

sentences.en: But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
sentences.core: they are inviting pressure。
sentences.structure: by giving in... 说明招致压力的方式；to make more concessions 修饰 pressure，说明压力将迫使其继续让步。
sentences.key: give in to：向……屈服、让步。；make concessions：作出让步。；behind the scenes：在幕后。；take aim at：把批评矛头对准。
sentences.zh: 但如今它们一旦向批评者让步，就等于招致更多压力，迫使自己作出更多妥协。
